objective: Decide whether to lend on a residential property, at what terms, with a recorded rationale for every outcome.
triggers: A mortgage application is submitted through the application portal

actors.name: Underwriter
responsibilities: Decide cases referred by the identity check or the credit decision

stages.name: Application intake
stages.purpose: Extract applicant, property, loan and income details from the form and evidence, check scope and completeness.

decision.question: Can the application be assessed? Evaluated in order; the first matching outcome wins.

stages.name: Return to applicant
stages.purpose: Tell the applicant why the application cannot be assessed: list the missing documents, or point an out-of-scope application to the right channel. Ends this run.
stages.notes: Reached only from intake. A resubmitted application starts a new run; this stage never loops back.

stages.name: Identity, fraud and credit check
stages.purpose: Verify identity, screen sanctions and fraud signals, and fetch the credit score.

decision.question: Is the applicant cleared to be assessed? Evaluated in order; the first matching outcome wins.

outcomes.label: refer
outcomes.condition: bureau_result.sanctions_hit is true, or bureau_result.identity_verified is false, or bureau_result.fraud_score >= 40

stages.name: Affordability assessment
stages.purpose: Calculate loan to value, debt to income and the monthly surplus at the stressed rate, from verified income only. A calculation, no model.

stages.name: Credit decision
stages.purpose: Apply the lending policy rules to the affordability and bureau results and record which rules passed or failed.

decision.question: Does the case meet lending policy? Evaluated in order; the first matching outcome wins.

outcomes.label: refer
outcomes.condition: affordability_result.ltv_pct > 85, or affordability_result.dti_pct > 45, or affordability_result.surplus_ratio_pct < 10, or bureau_result.credit_score < 640

outcomes.label: approve
outcomes.condition: Otherwise (LTV <= 85, DTI <= 45, surplus ratio >= 10, credit score >= 640)

stages.name: Underwriter review
stages.purpose: Decide cases referred by the identity check or the credit decision, and record the reasons.
stages.notes: Reached from identity_check (refer) or decision (refer). affordability_result and the automated decision_record exist only on the decision path. The underwriter's decision replaces decision_record with decided_by = underwriter.

stages.name: Issue mortgage offer
stages.purpose: Create the mortgage offer in the origination system, which sends it to the applicant. Ends the run.

stages.name: Send decline notice
stages.purpose: Write and send the decline letter, stating every reason recorded in the decision record. Ends the run.

business.description: Identity is verified and sanctions screened before any credit decision; a sanctions hit is never decided automatically.
Affordability is tested at the higher of the product rate plus 3 percentage points, or 7%.
Affordability uses income read from the evidence, never the income the applicant declared on the form.
No lending above 95% loan to value.
Every approve, refer and decline records the rules that produced it, and every decline notice states them.
A referred case is decided by an underwriter, never by the workflow.

technical.description: Credit bureau calls time out after 30 seconds and retry twice; after that the case is referred, never passed.
Every agent stage returns JSON matching its data entity; an output that does not match fails the step.
Applicant names, addresses and account numbers are masked in logs and run traces.
Offer creation uses the application id as an idempotency key, so a retry cannot issue a second offer.

exceptions.condition: Income evidence, proof of identity or the property valuation is missing or unreadable
exceptions.handling: List what is missing in application_record.missing_documents and route to return_to_applicant; do not assess.

exceptions.condition: The application is for buy-to-let or commercial property
exceptions.handling: Route to return_to_applicant with the channel that handles it; do not assess.

exceptions.condition: The credit bureau does not answer after the retries in bureau_timeout_retry
exceptions.handling: Refer to an underwriter with the reason; never treat a missing bureau result as clear.

risks.description: An applicant is declined without being told why.
risks.mitigation: decision_rationale on every outcome; the decline notice is written from decision_record.reasons.

risks.description: Declared income is higher than the evidence supports, so an unaffordable loan is approved.
risks.mitigation: verified_income_only; a gap above 10% between declared and verified income is flagged in the application record.

risks.description: Applicant personal data appears in logs or in a notice sent to the wrong address.
risks.mitigation: pii_masked_in_logs; notices go only to the contact address on the application record.

regulations.name: Anti-money laundering
regulations.requirement: Verify identity and screen sanctions before lending.

regulations.name: Responsible lending
regulations.requirement: Assess affordability from verified income, including under higher interest rates.

regulations.name: Data protection
regulations.requirement: Process applicant personal data only for the application and protect it in storage and logs.

data_entities.name: application_record
fields: purpose (one of: purchase, remortgage, buy_to_let, commercial)
income_gap_flag (boolean, verified income more than 10% below declared)
missing_documents (list of strings, empty when complete)

data_entities.name: affordability_result
fields: stressed_surplus (number, GBP per month, negative means unaffordable)
surplus_ratio_pct (number, % of monthly net income left after the stressed payment and commitments)

data_entities.name: decision_record
fields: reasons (list of strings, one per failed rule or underwriter reason)

business.name: Referral rate
business.description: Far outside this range means the refer thresholds need recalibrating.

technical.name: Automated path duration
technical.target: p95 < 5 minutes from submission to decision, excluding manual review

technical.name: Valid structured outputs
technical.target: >= 99% of agent outputs match their data entity on the first attempt

risk.reason: Binding credit decisions on personal data.

human_oversight.threshold: Every refer outcome from identity_check or decision

segregation_of_duties: The underwriter who decides a referral cannot have submitted or edited the application.

glossary.LTV: Loan to value: loan_amount divided by property_value, as a percentage.
glossary.DTI: Debt to income: monthly commitments plus the stressed monthly payment, divided by monthly net income, as a percentage.
glossary.Stressed rate: The higher of the product rate plus 3 percentage points, or 7%.
glossary.Surplus ratio: Monthly net income left after the stressed payment and commitments, as a percentage of monthly net income.
